# Vendor Registration & Dashboard

Vendors sign up on the EGSMA marketplace platform and manage their store from the Multi-Vendor Marketplace panel.

---

## 1. Register as a Vendor

1. Open the marketplace sign-up page.
2. Enter the required details and create an account.

![Create seller at EGSMA end](/images/createseller.webp)

---

## 2. Log In

Once registration succeeds, the vendor logs in to the panel.

![Seller login at EGSMA end](/images/sellerlogin.webp)

---

## 3. Vendor Dashboard

After logging in, the vendor lands on the **Multi-Vendor Marketplace Panel Dashboard**. From here the vendor manages their products and orders.

![Seller dashboard at EGSMA end](/images/sellerdashboard.webp)

Next: [Product Management](/vendor/product-management.md).
